_about: Audit thresholds. 'official' values come from platform docs (verified 2026-11-02); 'heuristic' values are industry rules of thumb (Google sets no title/description length limit — it truncates by pixel width). Override per project in .get-found/thresholds.override.json.

_sources.og_max_bytes: WhatsApp link previews: image < 600 KB, <head> within first 300 KB of HTML (developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/link-previews/)
_sources.og_min: Facebook recommends >= 1200x630, ~1.91:1, max 8 MB; X summary_large_image is 2:1, < 5 MB
_sources.html_max_bytes: Googlebot reads the first 2 MB of uncompressed HTML (developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/googlebot)
_sources.robots_max_bytes: RFC 9309: crawlers must parse at least 500 KiB
_sources.sitemap: 50,000 URLs / 50 MB uncompressed per file (Google + Bing)
